output_file.description: Path to the output file. Use '-' for stdout.

use_labels.description: If true, use labels instead of line numbers in input.

start_line.description: Starting line number for auto-generation in labels mode.

line_increment.description: Line number increment step in labels mode.

tap_filename.description: Filename to embed in the .TAP header (padded to 10 chars).

auto_start.description: If true, set the .TAP header to auto-run from start_target.

start_target.description: Line number or label to auto-start from.

raw_format.description: If true, output raw headerless Basic instead of .TAP.

input_files.description: List of input text files containing Spectrum Basic source code.
